title: Design System: Tsholofelo Ndawonde — Personal Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Playfair Display, 600 weight, clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 4.5rem).

headline.purpose: Section and page headings (h2/h3). Playfair Display, 700 weight.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy and taglines. Inter, 400 weight, with cv02/cv03/cv04/cv11 stylistic sets enabled.

label.purpose: Eyebrow labels, nav/footer meta, status readouts. Monospace, uppercase, 0.1em tracking.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for small surfaces (social icon buttons). Dark mode: 0 4px 20px -4px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.3).

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for content cards. Dark mode: 0 8px 30px -8px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.4).

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Primary-tinted glow on hover, paired with a -translate-y lift. Dark mode: 0 12px 40px -12px hsl(220 90% 60% / 0.3).

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Ring + deep glow reserved for the desktop mode's focused window.

motion.name: ease-scroll-reveal
motion.purpose: Default ease for all GSAP scroll reveals, hero entrance, and magnetic hover.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Easing for pure-CSS Tailwind animate-* utilities (bounce-in, spring-scale, elastic-scale).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Focus rings, color transitions, base interactive state changes.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Card hover, image hover-scale, link-underline growth, badge/social hover.

motion.name: duration-nav-morph
motion.purpose: Nav pill scroll-state transition (transparent to glass panel).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident Blue filled button; the main call-to-action shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: hsl(220 90% 56%); color: hsl(0 0% 100%); border: none; border-radius: 1.875rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px hsl(220 90% 56% / 0.2); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(60 20% 99%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(220 90% 56%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95) translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button; transparent fill, hairline border, fills to muted teal accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: transparent; color: hsl(220 25% 10%); border: 1px solid hsl(220 15% 90%); border-radius: 1.875rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(160 60% 45% / 0.12); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(60 20% 99%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(220 90% 56%); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.95) translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field; shares the button's 2px primary focus-ring language.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2.5rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: hsl(60 20% 99%); color: hsl(220 25% 10%); border: 1px solid hsl(220 15% 90%); border-radius: 1.875rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(220 10% 45%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(60 20% 99%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(220 90% 56%); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

narrative.overview: The system reads as a personal notebook kept by an engineer who writes carefully: editorial serif headlines (Playfair Display) carry narrative and credibility, while clipped monospace status lines — "System Operational," timestamps, eyebrow labels — stand in for handwritten margin annotations. Surfaces are warm rather than sterile: off-white paper backgrounds, primary-tinted soft shadows instead of flat neutral ones, and generously rounded interactive chrome that never feels corporate or cold. Underneath the warmth sits real technical craft: focus rings, hover-lift, and a full alternate "desktop OS" mode (boot screen, window chrome, taskbar) that exists purely to demonstrate engineering depth to the half of the audience qualified to notice it. Playful details — a confetti-triggering logo Easter egg, magnetic cursor-follow links, a hinted Konami code — signal personality without undercutting the credibility the serif/mono pairing establishes.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial serif display headlines (Playfair Display, 600–700 weight) paired with monospace "system status" accents for meta/label text.
Warm, off-white/blue-tinted surfaces with primary-hued soft shadows — never plain neutral black shadows.
Rounded-full pills for interactive chrome (nav, buttons, toggles); large 2xl–3xl radii for content containers (cards, mobile nav panel).
Tactile, springy micro-interactions: hover-lift, active:scale-95, magnetic hover, mousedown ripple.
A signature desktop-OS "Easter egg" mode (boot screen, draggable windows, taskbar) proving craft depth beyond the surface page.

rules.name: The Singular Accent Rule
rules.body: Confident Blue is the only color permitted to mean "active, selected, or important" — links, focus rings, active nav state, glows. Muted Teal only labels; it never takes on that role.

rules.name: The Serif-Only-For-Headings Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display is applied globally to h1–h6 and nowhere else. Body copy, buttons, and UI chrome never use the display face.

rules.name: The Tinted-Not-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Shadows always carry the primary hue at low opacity — never a plain black/gray shadow. Depth and brand identity are the same visual cue.

dos: Do keep Confident Blue as the only color that signals active/selected/important (links, focus rings, active nav, glows) — The Singular Accent Rule.
Do tint shadows with the primary hue instead of neutral black — The Tinted-Not-Neutral Rule.
Do reserve Playfair Display strictly for headings — The Serif-Only-For-Headings Rule.
Do pair hover states on cards and elevated buttons with a -translate-y lift plus a shadow increase, not a color change alone.
Do gate any new motion on prefers-reduced-motion, matching every existing GSAP/CSS animation in the codebase.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated brand color competing with Confident Blue — Muted Teal stays a rare, quiet label color.
Don't use the base Card primitive's default neutral, 0.5rem-radius styling for new content surfaces — match ProjectCard's rounded-2xl + shadow-card/shadow-hover tokens instead.
Don't reach for the unused custom breakpoints (xs, 3xl) or spacing steps (18, 88, 128, 144) without a real layout need — they're reserved capacity, not the working rhythm.
Don't add a custom cursor or new Easter-egg mechanics without matching the existing confetti palette (#4F93FF / #3DB89F / #FFD43B) and the reduced-motion gating pattern already used everywhere else.
